title: A Unified Analysis of Importance-Corrected Momentum Actor-Critic over a Markovian Trajectory
abstract: arXiv:2610.33477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a generic actor-critic method that combines a ridge-regularized pathwise least-squares temporal-difference (LSTD) critic with importance-corrected momentum (ICM) actors. The critic solves a ridge-regularized system per frame by Newton-Schulz inversion and needs no stepsize, no knowledge of the mixing time, and no rank condition. Averaging stochastic policy gradients over frames of $T$ consecutive transitions, the ICM actors incur a frame-dependent gradient bias of order $\frac{1}{T}$. To our knowledge, we establish the first finite-time bounds for ICM actor-critic methods with normalized and unnormalized steps along a single Markovian trajectory. Up to a stationary-to-discounted distribution mismatch, the averaged gradient norm over $K$ updates is bounded by ${\cal O}(K^{-1/3}+\frac{1}{T})$ for normalized steps and by ${\cal O}(K^{-1/4}+\frac{1}{T})$ for unnormalized steps. translated_title: 马尔可夫轨迹上重要性校正动量演员-评论家方法的统一分析
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种通用的演员-评论家方法，将岭正则化的路径最小二乘时序差分（LSTD）评论家与重要性校正动量（ICM）演员相结合。该评论家通过Newton-Schulz求逆在每个帧上求解一个岭正则化系统，无需步长设置、无需混合时间的先验知识，也无需秩条件。通过对 $T$ 个连续转移构成的帧上的随机策略梯度取平均，ICM演员会产生一个阶为 $\frac{1}{T}$ 的帧相关梯度偏差。据我们所知，我们首次为沿单条马尔可夫轨迹运行的ICM演员-评论家方法（涵盖归一化与非归一化步长）建立了有限时间收敛界。在平稳分布与折扣分布失配的误差范围内，$K$ 次更新后的平均梯度范数在归一化步长下被 ${\cal O}(K^{-1/3}+\frac{1}{T})$ 所约束，在非归一化步长下被 ${\cal O}(K^{-1/4}+\frac{1}{T})$ 所约束。我们还将这些界专门化到Muon、归一化随机（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了结合岭正则化LSTD评论家与重要性校正动量演员的通用演员-评论家方法，并首次建立了该方法在单条马尔可夫轨迹上采用归一化与非归一化步长时的有限时间收敛界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generic actor-critic method combining a ridge-regularized LSTD critic with importance-corrected momentum actors, and establishes the first finite-time convergence bounds for such methods over a single Markovian trajectory with both normalized and unnormalized stepsizes.
